**Finding submitted — MINCOMMIT: deviation (preferred-level cure).**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** §4.1/§4.2.2/§4.2.3 (p0380, p0381, p0396, p0399, p0402), §6.1–6.2 payment mechanics (p0489–p0521), and §14.2.2 at-will exit (p0755).
- **Issue:** §4.2.3(ii) requires PB to elect **no less than $110 million** of SFJ funding — a multi-year minimum draw that, via the §6.2 pro rata multiplier, locks PB into the corresponding Approval Payment exposure. No 12-month limit, no 30-day reduction right, no true-up in PB's favour, so it fails the fallback.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete the floor only — "which shall be no less than $110 million and no more than $120 million" → "which shall be no more than $120 million".
- **Element coverage:** no-minimum element addressed by the operation; "pays only for usage/ordered services" already met verbatim by §6.2's pro rata adjustment to Development Costs actually funded.
- **Not double-flagged:** the 300% at-will termination payment (§14.2.2) and the overrun/use-of-proceeds covenants are noted in the rationale only, left to the liquidated damages rule.
